mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comment (id, coeat_id, parent_id, user_id, content) VALUES (#{id}, #{coeatId}, #{parentId}, #{userId}, #{content})
mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.coeat_id, c.parent_id, c.user_id, c.content, r.created_at, r.updated_at, r.deleted_at, r.blinded_at FROM comment c JOIN root r ON c.id = r.id WHERE c.id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE comment c JOIN root r ON c.id = r.id SET c.content = #{content}, r.updated_at = NOW() WHERE c.id = #{id}
